CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS topics (
  post_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  topic text,
  destination text,
  language text,
  content_pillar text,
  priority text,
  notes text,
  status text,
  sources_found integer,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_versions (
  content_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  post_id text,
  version integer,
  parent_content_id text,
  destination text,
  language text,
  variation_label text,
  post_text text,
  char_count integer,
  status text,
  risk_level text,
  admin_approval_required boolean DEFAULT false,
  reviewer_name text,
  reviewer_decision text,
  publisher_name text,
  publisher_authorization text,
  admin_name text,
  admin_approval text,
  approved_hash text,
  approved_at timestamptz,
  scheduled_for timestamptz,
  published_at timestamptz,
  linkedin_urn text,
  post_url text,
  status_note text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_versions_post_id ON content_versions (post_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_versions_status ON content_versions (status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  entity_type text,
  entity_id text,
  action text,
  actor text,
  old_status text,
  new_status text,
  details jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  workflow_name text,
  execution_id text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_entity ON audit_log (entity_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS topic_slots (
  slot_no integer PRIMARY KEY,
  post_id text,
  execution_id text,
  locked_at timestamptz,
  expires_at timestamptz
);
INSERT INTO topic_slots (slot_no) SELECT generate_series(1, 3) ON CONFLICT (slot_no) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cost_ledger (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  post_id text,
  step text,
  provider text,
  model text,
  input_tokens integer,
  output_tokens integer,
  cost_usd numeric(10,5) DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cost_ledger_post_id ON cost_ledger (post_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS topic_budget (
  post_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  budget_usd numeric(10,4) DEFAULT 0.50,
  spent_usd numeric(10,5) DEFAULT 0,
  warning_sent boolean DEFAULT false,
  exceeded_sent boolean DEFAULT false,
  alert_now text,
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'public'
  AND table_name IN ('topics','content_versions','audit_log','topic_slots','cost_ledger','topic_budget')
ORDER BY table_name;

-- Migration 002 (schema v2). Repeatable: safe to run again. Test on a database copy first.
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_schema_versions (
  version     text PRIMARY KEY,
  description text NOT NULL,
  applied_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  applied_by  text DEFAULT current_user
);

-- ---------- topics ----------
ALTER TABLE topics
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS research_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_error text;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_topics_status ON topics (status);

-- ---------- topic_slots: one slot per topic (backstop for concurrent claims) ----------
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS topic_slots_one_slot_per_post
  ON topic_slots (post_id) WHERE post_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ---------- cost_ledger ----------
ALTER TABLE cost_ledger
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_key text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS execution_id    text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS content_id      text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pricing_version text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS usage_type      text;
UPDATE cost_ledger SET idempotency_key = 'legacy:' || id::text WHERE idempotency_key IS NULL;
UPDATE cost_ledger SET usage_type = 'estimated' WHERE usage_type IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE cost_ledger ALTER COLUMN idempotency_key SET NOT NULL;
DO $$ BEGIN
  -- Full (not partial) unique constraint: the gateway uses ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key),
  -- which a partial "WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL" index would not satisfy.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'cost_ledger_idempotency_key_uq') THEN
    ALTER TABLE cost_ledger ADD CONSTRAINT cost_ledger_idempotency_key_uq UNIQUE (idempotency_key);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'cost_ledger_usage_type_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE cost_ledger ADD CONSTRAINT cost_ledger_usage_type_chk CHECK (usage_type IN ('actual', 'estimated'));
  END IF;
END $$;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cost_ledger_execution ON cost_ledger (execution_id);

-- ---------- content_versions ----------
ALTER TABLE content_versions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_notes            text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_flags            text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_hash             text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_checked_at       timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_review_status    text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS approval_eligible     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_by_user_id   text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_at           timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_notes    text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_evidence jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_hash         text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_outcome  text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reviewer_user_id      text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reviewer_notes        text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reviewer_at           timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS publisher_user_id     text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS publisher_at          timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS admin_user_id         text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS admin_at              timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS approved_version      integer,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS superseded_by         text;
-- Human verification is sticky: once flagged, only record_verification clears it, for one exact hash.
UPDATE content_versions SET verification_required = true
WHERE NOT verification_required
  AND (status = 'Needs Human Verification' OR risk_review_status = 'Needs Human Verification');
DO $$ BEGIN
  -- NOT VALID: enforced for new/updated rows, existing over-length rows (pre-check 3) are left for review.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'content_versions_post_text_max_1250') THEN
    ALTER TABLE content_versions ADD CONSTRAINT content_versions_post_text_max_1250
      CHECK (post_text IS NULL OR char_length(post_text) <= 1250) NOT VALID;
  END IF;
END $$;
-- One revision per parent version: a second concurrent revision of the same version fails.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_content_versions_one_child_per_parent
  ON content_versions (parent_content_id) WHERE parent_content_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_versions_destination_status ON content_versions (destination, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_versions_scheduled_for ON content_versions (scheduled_for);

-- ---------- audit_log ----------
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_created_at ON audit_log (created_at);

-- ---------- user directory (authenticated identity, audit 4.5) ----------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  user_id          text PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name     text NOT NULL,
  email            text UNIQUE,
  email_verified   boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  telegram_user_id text UNIQUE,
  active           boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  backup_user_id   text REFERENCES users (user_id),
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_role_assignments (
  id               bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id          text NOT NULL REFERENCES users (user_id),
  role             text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('verifier', 'reviewer', 'publisher', 'admin')),
  destination      text NOT NULL CHECK (destination IN ('Personal', 'Company', 'Both')),
  can_self_approve boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  active           boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  granted_by       text,
  granted_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (user_id, role, destination)
);

-- ---------- immutable approval events ----------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_events (
  id              bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  content_id      text NOT NULL,
  version         integer,
  content_hash    text NOT NULL,
  stage           text NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('verification', 'reviewer', 'publisher', 'admin')),
  decision        text NOT NULL,
  actor_user_id   text NOT NULL,
  actor_channel   text,
  notes           text,
  evidence        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  old_status      text,
  new_status      text,
  execution_id    text,
  workflow_name   text,
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_events_content ON approval_events (content_id);

-- ---------- research sources ----------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_sources (
  id                bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  post_id           text NOT NULL,
  content_id        text,
  url               text NOT NULL,
  title             text,
  publisher         text,
  published_at      timestamptz,
  retrieved_at      timestamptz,
  validation_status text,
  rejection_reason  text,
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (post_id, url)
);

-- ---------- publishing attempts and global pause ----------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publishing_attempts (
  attempt_id    uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  content_id    text NOT NULL,
  version       integer,
  destination   text NOT NULL,
  execution_id  text NOT NULL,
  request_hash  text NOT NULL,
  slot_label    text,
  status        text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Publishing', 'Published', 'Failed', 'Unknown - Reconciliation Required', 'Confirmed Absent')),
  linkedin_urn  text,
  post_url      text,
  error_details text,
  claimed_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  finished_at   timestamptz,
  updated_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
-- One active-or-published attempt per content version; one in-flight publish per destination.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_publishing_attempts_active_content
  ON publishing_attempts (content_id) WHERE status IN ('Publishing', 'Unknown - Reconciliation Required', 'Published');
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_publishing_attempts_inflight_destination
  ON publishing_attempts (destination) WHERE status = 'Publishing';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publishing_controls (
  id            integer PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  paused        boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  paused_reason text,
  updated_by    text,
  updated_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
-- Starts PAUSED: LinkedIn publishing stays off until an Admin un-pauses it deliberately.
INSERT INTO publishing_controls (id, paused, paused_reason, updated_by)
VALUES (1, true, 'Initial state: publishing disabled until Admin signoff', 'migration 002')
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

-- ---------- append-only enforcement ----------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION li_block_update_delete() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only: % is not allowed', TG_TABLE_NAME, TG_OP;
END $$;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS approval_events_append_only ON approval_events;
CREATE TRIGGER approval_events_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON approval_events
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION li_block_update_delete();
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_log_append_only ON audit_log;
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_log
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION li_block_update_delete();

INSERT INTO workflow_schema_versions (version, description)
VALUES ('002', 'Schema v2: cost idempotency, risk/verification/approval columns, user directory, approval events, sources, publishing attempts, publishing pause')
ON CONFLICT (version) DO NOTHING;

COMMIT;

SELECT (SELECT string_agg(version, ', ' ORDER BY version) FROM workflow_schema_versions) AS applied_schema_versions,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'content_versions'
     AND column_name IN ('approval_eligible', 'verification_required', 'verified_hash', 'reviewer_user_id', 'publisher_user_id', 'admin_user_id', 'approved_version', 'superseded_by'))::int AS content_v2_columns_present_of_8,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public'
     AND table_name IN ('workflow_schema_versions', 'users', 'user_role_assignments', 'approval_events', 'content_sources', 'publishing_attempts', 'publishing_controls'))::int AS new_tables_present_of_7,
  (SELECT paused FROM publishing_controls WHERE id = 1) AS publishing_paused;
